newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait shares trade value hit record high in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait shares trade value hit record high in Sept.

text.p: The value of shares traded on the Kuwait Stock Exchange rose month-on-month 135.5 percent to a record 912.4 million dinars ($3.05 billion) in September, the exchange said on Sunday.
Traded volume also registered a record 4.468 billion shares, a rise of 108.7 percent from August's 2.14 billion. The exchange operates for 2-1/2 hours five days a week.
The share index gained 109.7 points or 6.7 percent to 1,735.8 points during the same period. It closed on Saturday at a record 1,812.1.
Gainers led loosers 42-14, while two were non-movers.
Property shares were the most active by volume, accounting for 31.2 percent. Investment firms came second with 30.8 percent and banks with 26 percent.
Banks were the most active by value with 38.3 percent, followed by property with 25 percent and investment stocks with 23.9 percent.
